title: Chapter 120 National Destiny
content:
Chapter 120 National Destiny

(I recently read the book reviews. I haven't read it for a long time, but I noticed that the score dropped by 0.1 points, so I took a look. Emm, how should I put it? It's a bit uncomfortable. Many people said that I wrote the protagonist as a big bootlicker. At first, I was a little confused. I saw that all the book reviews were comments on March 14th and 15th. The chapters posted on those two days were just when the heroine came back. Maybe I wrote the process of the heroine's return a little bumpy. In addition, I wrote a little slowly and the description was not very good. But the hero is not a bootlicker. Everything the heroine did was for the good of the hero. At least the original intention was good. There was no such thing as cheating on the hero. The two are in love. Love, but I didn't make it clear at the beginning, so there was a misunderstanding.

Some people said that I wrote it as pseudo-invincible. I wrote before that the system can allow the protagonist to maximize the knowledge, skills and proficiency of the realm, so the protagonist will be very strong at the same level, but not to the extent of invincibility. I set the setting of invincibility at the same level to the heroine. After all, we are all family members. It may be a bit exaggerated to write a single-handed beating, but I also want to highlight that the heroine is very evil. The most important thing is that although the hero is not invincible at the same level, he will never fight with others at the same level. Anyway, the cultivation level can be raised casually, and he will fight with others at the same level when he is full. If he wants to fight, he will naturally crush them)

In the hall.

Lu Daosheng raised his eyes and looked into the depths of the starry sky.

Nowadays, it is basically difficult for the strength of the deserted city to have any rivals.

In addition to the backhand he left behind, it can be said to be foolproof.

Next, he doesn't need to keep a close eye on the deserted city.

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly, and then waved his hand.

Buzz——

Suddenly, a crack in the void appeared before his eyes.

Lu Daosheng stepped in and disappeared in the hall.

......

To the border of the Divine Star Region.

At this moment, a terrifying army of millions of divine soldiers has been assembled here.

The fighting spirit is soaring, and the momentum is surging.

The whole world is shaking under the momentum of this army.

The leader is Wang Zhen.

"General, when will we set off?"

At this time, a soldier stepped forward and asked.

Hearing this, Wang Zhen had no expression on his face, but just said lightly: "Wait for orders."

"Yes, General."

Naturally, they did not dare to have any questions about Wang Zhen's orders.

After an unknown period of time, a figure came flying from a distance.

"Ahaha, sorry, sorry, I'm late."

Ao Qing came here with an apologetic look on his face.

Seeing Ao Qing, Wang Zhen was slightly stunned.

For some reason, he always felt that Ao Qing had become very different, and he seemed to be unable to sense any of his aura.

It seemed that His Majesty was afraid that Ao Qing would have an accident, so he specially prepared a treasure to hide his aura for him.

Thinking of this, Wang Zhen shook his head inwardly, and then shouted: "Let's go!"

Suddenly, this army of kings began to move forward.

A huge void crack appeared in front of the army.

Target, Tianlin Star Region!

And Wang Zhen's guess was not wrong. Yan Lingyun did prepare a treasure to hide the aura for Ao Qing.

But the purpose was not to protect Ao Qing.

......

In the Imperial Palace of the Divine Dynasty.

A beautiful figure was sitting cross-legged on the altar.

At the same time, a steady stream of light golden aura was constantly pouring into her body.

Adding national luck!

This is Yan Lingyun's purpose.

The larger and stronger the power of the Divine Dynasty, the more national luck Yan Lingyun can obtain.

As for the role of national luck.

Haha, that's really too much.

After all, if Yan Lingyun was interested in something and was willing to spend energy to create a divine dynasty, how could it be an ordinary thing?

After an unknown amount of time, Yan Lingyun slowly breathed a sigh of relief.

At this moment, she only felt refreshed.

At this moment, Yan Lingyun suddenly trembled all over, and the next moment, a warm and broad palm fell on her shoulders.

"Lingyun, this is the first time I see you wearing a dragon robe."

Behind him, Lu Daosheng smiled slowly.

Realizing the identity of the person behind him, Yan Lingyun's tense body suddenly relaxed, and then smiled: "Does it look good?"

"It looks good."

Lu Daosheng said without hesitation.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun's smile became even wider.

At this time, Lu Daosheng's strength had reached the peak of the lower world, and he was only half a step away from the fairyland.

This is also the reason why Yan Lingyun did not notice Lu Daosheng in advance.

"Daosheng, you came to see me, didn't you miss me?"

At this time, Yan Lingyun asked with a smile.

It had only been a short time, and Lu Daosheng actually came to see her.

However, she was very happy in her heart.

After hearing Yan Lingyun's words, Lu Daosheng laughed, "Why, don't you miss me?"

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun's face turned slightly red, and when she was about to say something, she suddenly felt her body floating in the air.

Suddenly, Yan Lingyun couldn't help but scream.

"Ah!!"

I saw Lu Daosheng directly hugged her by the waist.

"Daosheng, what are you doing?"

Being held in Lu Daosheng's arms, Yan Lingyun's face turned even redder, and she patted Lu Daosheng's chest lightly, and then said shyly.

A short separation is better than a new marriage.

At this moment, she didn't look like the powerful and invincible female emperor of the Divine Dynasty, but more like a little wife from a small family, favored and loved by her man.

Looking at Yan Lingyun's reaction, Lu Daosheng felt itchy in his heart.

Just when they were about to make the next move, the two of them changed their faces at the same time.

The next moment, a panicked voice suddenly sounded from outside the palace.

"Your Majesty, what happened?!"

Yan Lingyun's exclamation just now was obviously heard by the guards outside.

At this moment, a dense crowd of dragon guards had gathered outside the palace, and they were in great momentum. As long as Yan Lingyun gave an order, they would immediately rush in and strangle the thieves.

Inside the palace, Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun looked at each other.

"Hey, Lingyun, you deal with it first."

Lu Daosheng coughed lightly and said.

"Ah, oh."

Outside the palace, countless dragon guards were staring at the hall with tense expressions.

Your Majesty's voice just now was so horrified, presumably, he must have encountered some extremely powerful existence.

Even Your Majesty was a little overwhelmed.

Otherwise, how could he react so strongly.

Thinking of this, drops of cold sweat continued to condense on their foreheads.

At this moment, Yan Lingyun's voice suddenly came from the palace.

"This emperor is fine, everyone leave."

Hearing this, everyone was stunned, and then hurriedly said: "Yes, Your Majesty."

Soon, the outside world returned to calm again.

Since His Majesty said it was fine, then it was naturally fine.

But why did His Majesty suddenly call out? With this question, everyone went about their business.

At this time, in the palace, Lu Daosheng was already holding Yan Lingyun and slowly walking towards the dragon bed.

"Lingyun, don't you have any restrictions in this palace?"

Lu Daosheng asked as he walked.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun whispered: "With this emperor, with my ability, do I need these restrictions?"

This statement was extremely confident.

But Yan Lingyun just had this confident ability.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was slightly stunned, and then nodded in agreement.

However, the next moment, Lu Daosheng waved his sleeves, and a barrier directly wrapped the entire palace.

As for the purpose?

Hehehe.

Putting Yan Lingyun on the dragon bed, looking at Yan Lingyun in noble dragon robes and proud posture, Lu Daosheng felt extremely happy.

At this time, Yan Lingyun had closed her eyes and let you pick her.

"Lingyun."

"Hmm?"

"It's okay, I just feel like it's a bit like a dream."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun opened her eyes and met Lu Daosheng's sincere eyes.

The next moment, Yan Lingyun suddenly stood up, and then took the initiative and pressed Lu Daosheng under her.

"Whether it is a dream or not, you will know if you feel it."

Yan Lingyun smiled shyly, then leaned over and kissed him.
